title: The names of articles of dress worn by women or of certain soft and delicate stuffs used in their making brought always to his mind a delicate and sinful perfume.
html_source:
Les Jupes = Skirts.

The reference to “LES JUPES” brings to Stephen’s mind thoughts of woman’s undergarments, which is ironic because it is these sinful thoughts he has been trying to keep out of his mind, and they are being brought upon by none other than his Jesuit teachers.
